warnings: This is the FIRST sheet (แผ่นที่ 1/21) of the ฐานรากเสาเข็ม (pile-footing) cost variant of this house's BOQ -- the SECOND of two alternate 21-sheet BOQ documents for this house (a spread-footing / ฐานรากแผ่ variant was extracted separately on earlier pages of the same source document by a different pass; the two must not be merged, they price two different foundation designs for the same building).

PNG contains two portrait A3-spread sheets rotated 90 degrees (landscape scan, 3309x2339px, matching an A3 spread of two A4 portraits). Programmatically cropped into left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise for legibility, matching this project's established convention for these BOQ pages. This file is the physical RIGHT half (the lower-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 1/21, สรุปงาน), paired with แผ่นที่ 2/21 (หมวดงานโครงสร้าง, LEFT half) extracted as _2.json.

All 5 category rows and the grand-total row are printed with completely blank จำนวน/หน่วย/ราคา/จำนวนเงิน columns on this summary sheet by design -- it is a rollup pointer to the detail sheets that follow, not itself priced. Transcribed as null/blank, not invented.

Every page of this variant's running footer prints the house name as 'บ้านต้านภัยพิบัตรแผ่นดินไหว' (พิบัตร) while the sheet header consistently prints 'บ้านต้านภัยพิบัติแผ่นดินไหว' (พิบัติ) -- two different spellings of the same word, both genuinely printed as shown, throughout all 21 sheets of this variant. sheet_name above uses the header's spelling (พิบัติ, the grammatically standard form for 'disaster'); this is a source-document inconsistency, not a transcription choice, and is flagged once here rather than repeated on every sheet of this variant.

doc_page (76) read directly off this sheet: the two-digit running page number is printed once, bottom-centre, on the original landscape scan before splitting -- it straddles the left/right crop boundary, so '7' lands in the left-half crop and '6' in the right-half crop; reassembled as 76. Confirmed the doc_page = png_number - 2 offset holds across this whole variant (checked at both page78=76 and page88=86).
